prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 into 2019 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transferred liabilities of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 to the 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1686; the syndicate reports the financial impact of this transaction as nil.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was USD 2,113.637m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year adverse development (gross) of approximately USD 116.166m (c. 5.5% of opening gross reserves), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The movement reflects adverse development and large loss development across multiple older underwriting years, while 2022 actions (notably a loss portfolio reinsurance arrangement) provided reinsurance protection for professional lines relating to 2019 and prior years. The report also notes a decrease in claims notified relating to 2022 and prior years of USD 54.6m.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2022, the Syndicate completed a loss portfolio reinsurance contract ("LPR") with another Lloyd's syndicate. Under the agreement, the Syndicate was indemnified against potential adverse development in respect of net liabilities, providing the Syndicate with protection in several professional lines insurance portfolios, predominantly relating to 2019 and prior years of account.

Included within claims notified of USD 1,547.3m (2022: USD 1,398.0m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2022 and prior years of account of USD 54.6m (2022: decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of account of USD 229.9m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) derived from the published gross claims development triangle (cumulative gross estimates diagonal comparison) because the report does not present a single explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure. RITC into 2019 was disclosed (2021) but stated as having nil financial impact; LPR (2022) affects net/reinsurance recoveries. All amounts are in the report's functional currency (USD).
